desc: A rare thunder kirin, four-legged deer-horse creature, ivory body, one gold horn, short lavender mane crackling with small teal sparks, proud sharp eyes. High quality 16-bit pixel art game pet, crisp pixels, right-facing 3/4 view, full body, dark violet outline, pixel cluster shading with clear light and shadow, palette of lavender, pale violet, cream, ivory and deep navy, no props, no background.
